review_evidence.limitation: HEC-HMS and HEC-RAS results are accepted as official research reference; direct flow and sediment validation was not available in the source study.
The 2023 peak discharge is a modelled reconstruction and must not be treated as an observed gauged discharge.

notes: The Malanche 2023 case is closed as a RESEARCH_ONLY validation reference case using the 2024 SENAMHI report as the canonical available baseline; the zone contract itself remains DRAFT.
Original DTM, DSM, orthophoto and model project files are unavailable; published cartography and numeric references are accepted without claiming raw-data reprocessing.
Published basin morphometry is an independent comparison target and must not be used to tune IRFEN geometry.
The report-derived geometry is PARTIAL and has no machine-readable polygon in IRFEN; the geometry asset therefore has no map path and is not map-eligible.
Antioquia is retained as the representative rainfall reference selected by SENAMHI, not as a local Malanche gauge.
The 2023 reconstructed peak discharge is modelled, not observed.
Historical-event evidence remains PARTIAL because verified non-event controls have not been compiled to the contract minimum.

This research contract remains DRAFT while geometry, observations, verified non-event controls and forecast evidence are incomplete; activation remains BLOCKED, decision thresholds remain null and operational alerting remains disabled.
